stories.title: Dos muertos y un desaparecido en Cataluña por las lluvias torrenciales

en.title: Two dead and one missing in Catalonia from torrential rains
en.summary: Heavy rainfall in Catalonia has caused two deaths and one disappearance. Civil Protection has issued alerts for river overflow risk as rainfall intensifies in Girona.

stories.title: Marc Márquez suma su quinto 'pleno' de la temporada y se acerca a dos puntos de Jorge Martín

en.title: Marc Márquez achieves his fifth 'clean sweep' of the season and closes to two points of Jorge Martín
en.summary: Marc Márquez won in Japan, securing his fifth victory of the season and narrowing his championship gap to Jorge Martín to two points.

stories.title: Dos muertos y un desaparecido por el fuerte temporal en Cataluña

en.title: Two dead and one missing from severe storm in Catalonia
en.summary: A severe storm in Catalonia has killed two people and left one missing. A 75-year-old died when a wall collapsed at a camping site in Tordera, while a second victim was found in a flooded garage in Montornès del Vallès.

stories.title: Iñaki López, sobre el rechazo de Junts a los decretos de vivienda de Pedro Sánchez: «No es sorpresa. Votó contra la revalorización de las pensiones»

en.title: Iñaki López, on Junts' rejection of Pedro Sánchez's housing decrees: "It is no surprise. It voted against pension revaluation"
en.summary: Spain's Congress rejected two government housing decrees on October 2, with PP, Vox, Junts, and UPN voting against them. The measures included eviction suspensions and housing sector reforms.

stories.title: Marc Márquez supera de nuevo a Jorge Martín en el GP de Japón: el Mundial está en un puño

en.title: Marc Márquez again surpasses Jorge Martín at the Japanese GP: the World Championship is within reach
en.summary: Marc Márquez delivered a flawless race at Motegi to close to within two points of Aprilia leader Jorge Martín in the World Championship standings.

stories.title: El temporal de Cataluña deja dos víctimas mortales en Tordera y Montornès, un desaparecido en Pineda y Protección Civil manda un ES-Alert por riesgo de desbordamiento del río Besòs

en.title: The storm in Catalonia leaves two deaths in Tordera and Montornès, one missing person in Pineda, and Civil Protection issues an ES-Alert due to risk of Besòs river overflow
en.summary: A severe storm affected Catalonia causing two fatalities, one disappearance, and widespread flooding in Barcelona and surrounding areas, prompting flood warnings.

stories.title: La Policía Nacional inicia el desalojo del asentamiento de la playa del Trampolín en Ceuta

en.title: The National Police begin the eviction of the migrant settlement at Trampolín beach in Ceuta
en.summary: Spanish National Police launched the initial phase of an operation involving significant personnel and resources to dismantle part of a migrant encampment at a Ceuta beach.

stories.title: La Policía empieza a desalojar el asentamiento de migrantes de la playa de El Trampolín de Ceuta

en.title: Police begin dismantling the migrant settlement at El Trampolín beach in Ceuta
en.summary: Dozens of officers participated in an operation to dismantle the migrant campsite, with the Interior Ministry deploying heavy vehicles for this complex undertaking in Ceuta.

stories.title: Dos muertos por el temporal y máxima alerta ante el riesgo de que el río Besòs se desborde

en.title: Two dead from storm and maximum alert over risk of Besòs river overflow
en.summary: A storm has caused two deaths, and authorities have raised alert levels due to the danger of the Besòs river flooding.

stories.title: La mayoría del PSOE y el Gobierno anima a Sánchez a convocar elecciones ya: “Ahora hay una oportunidad”

en.title: Most PSOE members and the Government encourage Sánchez to call elections now: 'There is an opportunity now'
en.summary: Most Spanish Socialist party members and government officials are urging the Prime Minister to hold early elections, though some believe additional legislative measures should be attempted first.

stories.title: Dilema en el PSOE mientras Sánchez ultima su decisión: "Calentar más calle" o convocar y "hacérselo pagar ya al PP"

en.title: Dilemma in the PSOE as Sánchez finalizes his decision: 'Heat up the streets' or call elections and 'make the PP pay now'
en.summary: Socialist party members are divided between those favoring early elections and those preferring to delay while the left organizes, with recent protests failing to provide a clear consensus.

stories.title: Sánchez usó a Zapatero como baza con Junts para intentar salvar los decretos de vivienda

en.title: Sánchez used Zapatero as leverage with Junts to try to save housing decrees
en.summary: The Spanish government coordinated with former president Zapatero to contact the Junts party leadership after the party announced it would vote against housing-related government decrees.

stories.title: La Agencia Tributaria empieza a pagar el martes las ayudas directas a empresas y autónomos de Ceuta

en.title: Tax Agency begins paying direct aid to businesses and self-employed in Ceuta on Tuesday
en.summary: Starting October 6, Spain's Tax Agency will distribute government assistance to Ceuta businesses and self-employed workers to help them cope with economic effects from mass migration in late July.

stories.title: Brasil: la pieza que le falta a la marea conservadora en América Latina

en.title: Brazil: the piece missing from the conservative wave in Latin America
en.summary: Brazil holds the first round of its presidential election on Sunday, featuring a contest between leftist Lula and far-right candidate Flavio Bolsonaro.

stories.title: La estrategia 'cripto' que da rendimientos de hasta el 10%

en.title: The 'crypto' strategy that yields up to 10%
en.summary: Staking is becoming increasingly popular as a method where cryptocurrency holders lock tokens in a wallet to support transaction validation.

en.title: Great Bargain, I'm from Tehran...
en.summary: During the 1980s Madrid Movida, Almodóvar and McNamara performed a song titled "Gran Ganga, soy de Teherán" that was featured in the director's film "Labyrinth of Passions".

stories.title: La oferta de alquiler se hunde un 61% desde 2020 y los precios se disparan un 40%

en.title: Rental supply plummets 61% since 2020 while prices soar 40%
en.summary: Long-term rental housing availability has dramatically declined across major Spanish cities, with Barcelona experiencing a 90% drop since 2020, alongside significant price increases.
